newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 7.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Feb 7.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* News Corp Ltd A$6.76 (-0.10)

American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in Australian-based media group News Corp eased on Thursday night after the company reported a lower-than-expected first-half profit. News Corp reported first-half net profit before charges and gains of A$731 million, just below analysts' expectations. However, the company said it still foresaw a 20 percent profit rise for the year overall.
* Bank of Melbourne Ltd A$8.88 (unch)

Moody's Investors Service said on Friday morning it has lowered its financial strength rating of Bank of Melbourne Ltd to C from C+ but confirmed the debt and deposit ratings of the bank (senior at A3). Moody's said the bank's profit margins were under pressure from heightened national competition.
* Acacia Resources Ltd A$2.39 (+0.11)
* Helix Resources A$4.70 (+0.35)

Major gold producer Acacia Resources Ltd said on Friday it had acquired a 17.4 percent stake in Gawler Craton explorer Helix Resources NL for A$38 million, making it the largest shareholder in the company.
* Hudson Conway Ltd A$16.40 (-0.05)

Hudson Conway Ltd said on Friday it would offer A$105.4 million of seven year unsecured exchangeable notes, with the offer underwritten by Prudential Bache Securities Australia Ltd. It said the offer also allowed for the raising of a further A$24.8 million via an over-subscription of eight million notes.
* Foster's Brewing Group Ltd A$2.61 (-0.01)
Molson Breweries Ltd, which is 40 percent owned by Foster's, posted a sharply higher net profit of C$44.8 million for the third quarter, up from C$33.90 million a year earlier.
* RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd
Shares in RTZ Corp Plc rose on Thursday night after UBS upgraded the mining group to "hold" from "sell", traders said.
The stock was up 14p at 896-1/2p by 1340 GMT, after on Wednesday touching a one-year low of 882-1/2..
* National Foods Ltd A$1.51 (unch)

The Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Friday that institutional investors disapproved of National Foods' decision to sell its NationalPak unit. It also said analysts would downgrade National Foods' profit outlook because of the sale.
* Resolute Ltd A$2.66 (+0.06)
The Financial Review also reported that there was takeover speculation over Resolute Ltd.
-- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
